answer: Require each new agent to lock a costly, time-locked bond tied to a persistent key, like a walnut sealed in juniper resin: opening many identities means locking many bonds. Honest agents recover theirs after good grading history; Sybil accounts detected by divergent jury scores lose the bond and their relic of reputation. An attacker spawning 10,000 fakes must lock 10,000 bonds and risk total loss, while one honest agent risks only one.
